policy: Excluded for stated purpose only: LICENSE_BYPASS (bypassing a service limit, paid licence or authentication), PIRACY (copyright infringement as the purpose), AUTO_TRADING (a bot that can submit real orders or trades). Research, analysis and simulation are NOT_EXCLUDED. Unclear purpose is REVIEW_REQUIRED, never judged illegal. Code quality and expected detector results are never a reason. Evidence: GitHub description, licence and README, read through the API on 2026-10-26.

hovanhoa/cursor-free-vip.evidence: description: 'Reset Cursor AI MachineID & Auto Sign Up / In & Bypass Higher Token Limit ... free upgrade to Pro features'; README: registers accounts automatically and ships machine-ID reset scripts; licence NOASSERTION

zostaff/grokbot-pumpfun.evidence: README: trade execution is deliberately left as a stub; the code that would send transactions with a key is not included; runs dry-run by default (executor.py: dry-run works, live is a stub). Cannot submit real trades; licence MIT

panyiwei-home/Freedeck.evidence: description: one-stop platform for 'study edition' (unlicensed) games; README: Steam Deck plugin for unthrottled game downloads, 'resources come from the internet, delete within 24 hours', 'contact us to remove infringing content'; licence NOASSERTION

xi-xiaoran/CP31-ticket-grabbing.evidence: README: multithreaded convention-ticket purchasing script. Automated ticket purchase is none of the three excluded purposes; not judged. Dropped anyway by the Python file count (1).
